description: Aménagements cyclables dans les Alpes de Haute-Provence is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département des Alpes de Haute-Provence. Recensement des aménagements cyclables ou utiles aux cyclistes, réalisés et gérés par le conseil départemental des Alpes de Haute-Provence: voie verte, pistes cyclables, bandes cyclables, bandes multifonctions. Coverage: Département des Alpes de Haute-Provence. The publisher named on the listing is Département des Alpes de Haute-Provence. Its keywords include voirie, bande, voie-verte, amenagement, cycliste, route. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
